description: An environment, by view: variables, the names of its variables and secrets (never the values); domains, its domains and their DNS proof; links, its access links (never the link); backups, the last 50 backups of a database (their id for restore_backup); queues, its queues and their state.

database.description: Database name; the first declared by default.

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

name: get_environment
title: Read an environment
